snippet.title: Kitchen Tidy Trailer
snippet.description:
Kitchen Tidy is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 2,500 kitchen items and return everything to its proper place. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy kitchen into a perfectly organized space at your own pace.

Steam Link:https://store.steampowered.com/app/5020760/Kitchen_Tidy/
